notes.title: BREADSKATE: BREADVILLE REBAKED (NEW TRAILER) + Development Update.
notes.content:
[h1][b][i]BREADVILLE REBAKED[/i][/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="BZC5QJEqb5A;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]BREADSKATE has been in development for a while, hasn't it?[/h2][p]Well, a lot has happened in my life. Not going to go through all the tragic, sad or happy, weird and annoying details in here. But [b][i]BREADSKATE[/i][/b] has been with me the whole time, and it's like a son to me now. I'm never cancelling it or even worse, abandoning the game, even if I don't post a lot of updates publicly. I'm always working on it! With this trailer I can safely tell you that I'm set on a release window - Q1 2026 [strike]not saying that it's a final date but it will be out around that time trust me.[/strike] 
[b]Let's go through some Development Updates! I've got a lot to tell you![/b][/p][h3]This new gameplay trailer showcases the main thing I've been working on recently - Remaking the first location, [b]Breadville[/b]. [/h3][p]Breadville was originally the first ever level for breadskate that I made. The first iteration was made around [i]October 2020[/i], and I've been using it as a base, shaping it into the version that I later put in [b]Demo 2.0 in 2022.[/b][/p][p]Even when that demo was released, I wasn't 100% happy with the way the level looked. It was clearly outdated, and over the years I have improved my modelling and designing skills. I tried to improve this old version, but nothing really worked, nothing helped with that old poorly designed layout and concepts.[/p][p]So, some time ago I decided to completely remake it from scratch. Made a new layout, reshaped it in a way that looks and [i]feels [/i]dense, while still having enough freedom and variety to it. [/p][p]The gameplay layout was mostly the easiest thing to nail down. But once I got to working on art direction of this level, to making models and designing objects and environments, I hit a wall. I'm not a concept artist, and generally I never was best at designing environments for whole levels. I got stuck in this "art block" for literally [b]months[/b]. Development hasn't been completely stuck though, I was still working on technical aspects of the game, and specifically Duck Rivals, but this level was leaving me restless for a while.[/p][h3][/h3][h3]By that time I have started [b]working[/b] on a small gamejam side project to not get too burnt out with BREADSKATE, and released it January. [/h3][h3]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391350/WHITE_CHOCOLATE"][/dynamiclink][b]WHITE CHOCOLATE[/b] was a unique project for me and it was very refreshing and taught me several important things.[/h3][p]The most important thing at that time for me was changing my approach to level design.[/p][p]White chocolate was a 3-ish week project, and with time restrictions I didn't have time to overthink level design, and I changed my approach completely. My new approach was pretty basic - separate the level into two or three "themes/ideas" and give those ideas a solid reference. [/p][p]Later I applied it to Breadville and here's what I got. [/p][h3]Breadskate is very unserious game, and I had to reflect this with level design as well.[/h3][p]I was overthinking the environments a little too much, but now I'm looking at it as a creative "Playground" for all things that can be related to the theme of the level.[/p][p]Theme of breadville was simple - [b]Bread City[/b]. [/p][p]"Main Plaza" now has a Giant fridge and Bread Knives that act as rails to grind and jump from[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/b867b3773f01948316e4d6d5954d87f74a97b474.png"][/img][/p][p]Breadville is a Coastal City by original concept, so I reused this idea in this new version as well. There's a much more natural skatepark on this beach, and some nicer decorations to fit it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/036b636f7619ee5fde70243e0eaa4dec4b1844aa.png"][/img][/p][p]This change of level designing approach to a more unserious, more fitting the nature of Breadskate, has significantly helped accelerate the progress. Right now the level is about 95% done, while before it was stuck at 35% for months. [/p][p][/p][p]Besides Breadville, I also worked on some other new gameplay systems, like:[/p][list][*][p]Bread Deformation. The deformation system was remade from scratch, now utilizing Lattices for better precision and overall better look and feedback. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/d6ab344de4218e6ad2eb3a874bc40531ff14d128.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Duck Rivals. It can be seen in the trailer, it's like second biggest point after breadville in there. Duck Rivals have pretty flexible pathfinding behaviours, they can go through same ramps as the breadskate and do tricks to style on you while chasing. [/p][/*][*][p]Wheelie/Manual trick - You can now balance your loaf to stand on two wheels for extra points and extending the combo timer. Still WIP, no UI for that but it works pretty well so far.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/7e3d222b44b0b77f7efe32d39b610246496a8e8c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Improved landing. Bread will now slightly readjust it's rotation to assist landing, resulting in much smoother gameplay flow. The strength can be readjusted, and it's still undergoing balancing so not much to say yet. But it feels [b]much[/b] better to do combo streaks now![/p][/*][*][p]Toaster skills. Ground pound - anti-duck attack in an area and quick landing.[/p][/*][*][p]Special tricks. Charging toaster allows you to use a special trick to activate the toaster cannon. [/p][/*][/list][h3]While working on Breadville, I also participated in another gamejam and started working on my second side project to improve my skills.[/h3][p]While from technical point most of breadskate's gameplay worked just fine, I still had a thought that it doesn't [i]feel[/i] as great and fun as I imagined it to be. With this gamejam project I focused on improving my skills at delivering a better [b][i]game feel. [/i][/b]I paid more attention to camera movements, visual and audio feedback and the flow of player controller.[/p][p]I teamed up with my friend who's working on most of the 3D Art and all of Sound Design and Music, and we made a high-octane speed-fishing game. [/p][p]This project would later be named [b][i]FISH³.[/i][/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641250/FISH"][/dynamiclink][b][i]FISH³ [/i][/b]as a side project had one major task and it succeeded at it pretty early. I nailed down the game feel and the desired craziness pretty much right away. [/p][p]By that time (that was in Spring 2025), I got stuck in a pretty difficult position in my life, and I needed more money. But breadskate was nowhere near completion and I was not going to sell it in an unfinished state after all those years, So I decided to take this side project a little further. By Next Fest June 2025, I released a Demo for [b][i]FISH³ [/i][/b]and I set the goal to release this game [b][i]this summer. [/i][/b][/p][p]Like with White Chocolate, I'm learning a ton of new skills and improving my old skills. I'm slowly applying it to breadskate as well. [/p][h3][b][i]While FISH³ is my main project for the summer, I'm still going to work on BREADSKATE for at least a couple days a week. [/i][/b][/h3][p][b][i]FISH³ will release this summer, and later this year I will release a new Demo for Breadskate. It will include New Breadville, updated handling, new challenges and of course Ducks.[/i][/b] [/p][p]I'm not announcing strict dates as of now, but stick around and you'll find out soon!! 
In meantime, you can try out[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668460/FISH_Demo/"] FISH³ Demo [/url]right now! It turned out pretty fun for a small side project! 

Right now I post about development on [url="https://twitter.com/LaZrick_" style="button"]Twitter[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/breadskate.how" style="button"]Bluesky[/url] pretty frequently, so make sure to follow there to stay up to date on news!![/p][p]Thank you for your support and thank you for staying with me![/p]

notes.title: BREADVILLE INVASION!!! DEMO UPDATE!!!!
notes.content:
[h1]BREADSKATE DEMO 2.1 SMALL UPDATE: HALLOWEEN EVENT[/h1]

[h3]This is a small update that includes several internal code improvements meant to enhance in-air controls, as well as adding a new [b]Halloween Event Mode[/b].

A much bigger update that will be the [b]New Breadskate Demo[/b] is currently in the works, it will include a completely newly remade Breadville, majorly improved player controller, new tricks system, [i]possibly [/i] rival ducks, and many more technical changes that I have made to the main game, but could not port to this demo, as this was a very outdated branch. 

[b]Stay tuned, as the Bakery is heating up the oven once again[/b]. 
[/h3]

[h2]Changelog: [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved in-air controls.[/b]
[*] [b]Halloween Mode switch in Main Menu and Pause Menu.[/b]
[*] [b]Night time.[/b]
[*] [b]INVASION!?? THEY'RE STEALING OUR BRICK?? GO GET TH- 👽 ZEEBLE WORP ↬⮜⍚ ⌦☈⟟⍧⏧⎎ .[/b]
[*] [b]Pumpkinskate - Halloween version of Donutskate, obtainable for collecting all the donuts on the map.[/b]
[*] [b]Halloween decorations across the island.[/b]
[*] [b]Improved color corrrection - removed blue tint. Bread is now more bread colored. It really was THIS bad back then in the demo?? Damn.[/b]
[*] [b]Some bugs and crash fixes.[/b]
[/list]

Thank you for your support and thank you for playing the Demo. See you again soon!

notes.title: THREE YEARS IN THE OVEN??!!
notes.content:
[h1]woah its already been [b]3 years[/b] huh?[/h1]
[h3]thank you for still supporting and wishlisting breadskate.
sadly this year i don't think i can make a full compilation of clips like last year (see in the bottom if you missed it), but I'll post some "dev thoughts" here. [/h3]

[previewyoutube=9AS_ytQK5hc;full][/previewyoutube]

This year was a disaster for me. I didn't have that much time to work on the game, but I remained confident that I should never stop and leave it midway. It's something I'm just passionate about, and so I continued to work on code and reinforcing the game's structure.

I've learned a lot during this game's development and I became more confident with my coding compared to where I was in 2020. A bunch of game's old core code wasn't really well expandable, so I had to rework some systems (like [b]tricks![/b] posted a little clip on that not so long ago).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/f4a76b4d77976e492acf9e4e5e07ae7c6f5eaa4d.gif[/img]

Another thing that needed attention is my [b]level design[/b]. It needed more details, both on gameplay and visuals side. The first location (featured in demo 2.0) had a nice idea, but it was old, and wasn't as good and fun as I wanted it to be.
The third location, [b]Duck City[/b], is a big point for story mode and it's still the most unfinished one. I knew what I want it to be, but I wasn't sure how to actually build its environment. But I've gotten better and I had some help, so hopefully someday I can show more of it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/a1be682fc566ab87d9b55a5a231baff87b8d873f.gif[/img]

I really want the game to be a nice media piece, and not just a compilation of random stuff that doesn’t really make sense. Breadskate is still going to be just a silly little game with nothing really serious in it, but I want the whole structure of it to feel pretty solid. [i]It takes time.[/i]

[b]Thank you everyone who was somehow involved in the development, who contributed, who helped and supported me.[/b] And of course, to everyone who tried the demo and added the game to their wishlists. It really warms my heart. 

Check out the video I made last year if you haven't already seen it. I compiled some old and nostalgic clips from the development of the game there:
[previewyoutube=ksppbvVtHO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Twitter is dying right now, but if it gets better, you can follow me there: [url=https://twitter.com/LaZrick_] @LaZrick_ [/url]. [b]However, if it doesn't[/b], I will use steam news more often, as well as posting small stuff on youtube.[/h3]

notes.title: BREADSKATE DEMO 2.0 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[h1]BREADSKATE DEMO 2.0 major update is released for Steam Next Fest![/h1]

[h2]Major additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] First map from the full game.
[*] Timed challenges: Time Trial, Trick Combo and Top Speed.
[*] Breadskate modes that can be changed mid-game.
[*] Introduction tutorial.
[*] Wheel Grab trick and Rail Grind.
[*] Save system and quick checkpoints.
[/list]

[h2]Small additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements and leaderboard.
[*] New particles.
[*] Custom loaf loading from [i]/custom/loaves/[/i] folder.
[*] .. some other quality of life features I lost track of but still added.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed tricks control system: to start rotating in air you need to press inputs again after jump.
[*] Donuts collectibles progress can now be saved.
[*] Focused boost is no longer controlled by view, using in-air rotation instead.
[*] New procedural skybox.
[*] Improved camera follow system (can be changed to old in game if needed).
[*] Various shaders improvements.
[*] Improved gamepad support.
[*] Fixed UI for 21:9 and 16:10 aspect ratio.
[/list]

[h3]Added text localization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Polish
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 500 WISHLISTS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817826/ea2d171dd5b6c8b4d238b8f1349611ed957fd3ac.png[/img]

[h2]This is our first big achievement, my [i]bread[/i] people![/h2]

For someone this number might seem small, compared to other games. 
But I, personally, didn't even think we'd come this far. To be honest, I didn't even think we'd make a steam page for this game, but for some reason it happened and I'm really glad it happened.
This project wasn't meant to be a full game at start, and now what? Now I'm working on it almost as it's my full time job.

And to my surprise, there are actually many people discovering this game completely randomly! I guess this game is actually appealing to you, haha!

I'm really happy that I'm working on this project and that someone actually likes it. This whole game is an experiment for me, and through this year I've learned many new things just to implement something cool in this game. And you know what? It's fun!

I want to say thank you all for your support!
For your kind words, for your recommendations, tests and even donations on [url=https://lazrick.itch.io/breadskate]Itch.io[/url] demo. (didn't expect last one to happen and was really surprised, thanks :) )

[h3]Remember to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/LaZrick_]Twitter[/url], I'm posting updates about the game and things I'm working on there![/h3]
